title: PowerPoint on desktop: attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, image-attachment workflow and licence-assignment controls are supported. It distinguishes general Copilot controls from a feature-specific switch and appropriately leaves image-specific licensing details open.

claims.quote: Review the generated slides that incorporate the referenced image.

claims.quote: Searched: release-notes 555881; PowerPoint Agent Mode attached images processing permissions. Read the complete October 27 image-reference entry: it describes the Copilot pane and generated slides, without mentioning Agent Mode.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Image referencing is user-opt-in: the user chooses to attach an image, without a documented feature-specific admin enablement step.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint image attachment settings; reference attached images administrator disable Graph PowerShell policy. Read release-note steps, Copilot admin-center settings and privacy controls: user attaches an image; no feature-specific enablement switch found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The included licensing model describes a new option within licensed Copilot in PowerPoint, rather than a separately licensed product.
claims.quote: You have the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license with access to the full experience of Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on licence provides the full Copilot experience in PowerPoint.
claims.quote: You have the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license with access to the full experience of Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.

claims.claim: Users without the add-on licence can use Copilot in PowerPoint under the Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) experience.
claims.quote: You don't have the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license but can use Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.

claims.claim: Chat experiences in Word, Excel and PowerPoint vary by user licence and tenant configuration.
claims.quote: Chat experiences in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint vary depending on the user's license and tenant configuration.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically published whether this image-reference option is included in Basic or requires the add-on licence.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint attach image Agent Mode license pricing; reference attached images license Basic pricing; image referencing license meter. Read Copilot overview, requirements and image release note; only general in-app entitlements found, not this option's tier.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate price specific to image referencing is published in the checked sources.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint attach image Agent Mode license pricing; reference attached images license Basic pricing; image referencing license meter. Read roadmap 555881, image release note, Copilot overview and requirements; no image-reference-specific price found.

claims.claim: No meter is documented for this image-reference feature at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint attach image Agent Mode license pricing; image referencing license meter; reference attached images license Basic pricing. Read roadmap, image release note, Copilot overview and requirements; billing for other agents does not establish a meter for this option.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is reached in the Microsoft 365 admin center through Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses.
claims.quote:
In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page.
Select a product.
On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns the selected licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least the License Administrator or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; controls[0].scope; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: User-level Copilot licence assignment governs entitlement to the licensed Copilot in PowerPoint experience.
claims.quote: You have the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license with access to the full experience of Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented licence-assignment operation assigns a licence, rather than independently toggling image attachment.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Turning off connected experiences that analyze content on organizational devices makes Microsoft Copilot unavailable in PowerPoint.
claims.quote:
If you turn off connected experiences that analyze your content on devices in your organization, Microsoft Copilot features won't be available to your users in the following apps:
- Excel
- OneNote
- Outlook
- PowerPoint
- Word

claims.claim: No feature-specific administrator setting for image attachment is documented, including in the feature's release note.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot admin-center PowerPoint image attachment settings; reference attached images administrator disable Graph PowerShell policy. Read image release note, Copilot settings and privacy controls; general controls exist, but no image-attachment-specific switch found.

claims.claim: No checked source says existing behaviour changes for users who do not attach an image.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode attached images processing permissions sign-in administrator existing behavior. Read roadmap 555881 and complete image release-note entry; both describe optional image referencing, not a change to non-attachment workflows.

claims.claim: The release note says this update does not alter security or privacy controls.
claims.quote: This update improves content integration without altering security or privacy controls.

claims.claim: The release note describes no new permission for attaching an image.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode attached images processing permissions sign-in administrator existing behavior. Read the complete image release-note entry; it gives prompt, attachment and slide-review steps, without a new permission requirement.

claims.claim: The release note describes no new identity step for attaching an image.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint attach image Agent Mode license pricing admin policy minimum build; attached images processing permissions sign-in. Read the complete image release-note entry; no new identity step appears.

claims.claim: The release note describes no new sign-in step for attaching an image.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode attached images processing permissions sign-in administrator existing behavior. Read the complete image release-note entry; it starts with opening PowerPoint and gives no new sign-in step.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described Agent Mode's image handling beyond image referencing and slide generation in the checked documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode attached images processing permissions; attach image Agent Mode license pricing admin policy. Read image release note and roadmap. Results about Word, Excel and PowerPoint Agents in the Copilot app describe a different surface, not this workflow.

claims.claim: The roadmap record and this feature's release note state no minimum PowerPoint build.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint attach image Agent Mode license pricing admin policy minimum build. Read roadmap 555881 and complete October 27 image release-note entry; neither specifies a minimum build. API requirement-set results concern add-ins, not this feature.

claims.claim: The roadmap record and this feature's release note state no administrator role required to use image referencing.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint attach image Agent Mode license pricing admin policy; attached images processing permissions sign-in administrator. Read roadmap 555881 and complete image release note; no administrator role for using the feature is specified.
